children: Weatherford will redeem all $236 million of its 8.625% Senior Notes due 2030 at 100% plus accrued interest, with a redemption date of October 30, 2026.

Redemption price is 100% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest through Oct 30, 2026.
Redemption is expected to be funded using cash on hand, reducing outstanding debt.
